campaign: C11RD-R1 -- pre-result proof-convention and execution-boundary repair (successor of the C11RD freeze)

A_D1_statement.mathematics: for every e in [680769/400000, 17885921/10000000]: |d'_e(a)| <= D1, where d_e = Ghat_e h_1, Ghat_e = (I - Khat_e)^(-1) on bounded functions on R, h_1(p, m) = 1 - Phi(C - p + e) + Phi(m - C + e), Khat_e the one-step kernel with density phi(z + e) on the alarm-free window [m - C, C - p] minus the atom window [m - K, K - p], K = 1/2, C = 11/2, a = (0, 0), ' = d/de

record.state_set: R = {(p, m) in [0,5]^2 : p + m <= 4 or p = 0 or m = 0}; atom a = (0, 0); certified over a box cover that is a superset of R
record.proposition: for every e in the block: |D_e'| <= value

record.quantity: |d''(atom)|, the second drift derivative of d
record.state_set: R = {(p, m) in [0,5]^2 : p + m <= 4 or p = 0 or m = 0}; atom a = (0, 0); certified over a box cover that is a superset of R

C_drift_block.read_from: C11R statement table drift_domain (blob-bound); runner guard R6

D_sub_block_partition.rule: equal closed sub-blocks, exact rationals, tiling the block exactly
D_sub_block_partition.per_sub_block: own float proposal at the exact centre e_c; e-Taylor candidates about e_c; boxes never split in e

E_state_domain_partition.state_set: R = bands 0-3 (closed strips k <= p + m <= k + 1, p, m >= 0) and band 4 (the axis segments p + m in [4, 5] with p = 0 or m = 0)

initial_boxes.coordinates: p = s (1 + theta)/2, m = s (1 - theta)/2; band 4 by s on each axis

refinement.rule: bisect (s, theta) (band 4: s) while some |r_k| bound exceeds its tolerance and depth < max_depth; lam_k = max over ALL leaves

E_state_domain_partition.kink_rule: every box lies in ONE closed band (Box refuses otherwise); piece structure fixed per band (theory Lemma 1)

band_ownership.convention: UPPER-CLOSED: band 0 = s in [0, 1]; band k = s in (k, k + 1] for k = 1, 2, 3 (axis points included); band 4 = axis points with s in (4, 5]
band_ownership.completeness: c11rd_certify.verify_cover proves EXACTLY that the band-k boxes partition the closed strip [k, k+1] x [-1, 1] (k = 0..3) and the band-4 boxes partition [4, 5] on each axis; runner guard R6 refuses otherwise
band_ownership.replaces: the lower-closed 'half-open convention' text of the predecessor freeze's theory (review B-1)

chain: d' = Khat d' + Khat' d + h_1'
d'' = Khat d'' + 2 Khat' d' + Khat'' d + h_1''
F_derivative_recurrence.derivative_kernels: Khat^(i) f(x) = int_window-minus-atom f(x'(z)) (-1)^i He_i(z + e) phi(z + e) dz
residuals: r1 = D1(e) - Khat D1(e) - Khat' D0(e) - h_1'
r2 = D2(e) - Khat D2(e) - 2 Khat' D1(e) - Khat'' D0(e) - h_1''

propagation.D2_j: |D2(a)| + |D3(a)| de + tau (lam2 + 2 kappa_1 n1 + kappa_2 n0)

premise.certificate: C11R F_H (ACCEPTED; sealed runs blob a53516031948cf44255d7980dc5c7af5ae8b2afd at seal 5ff4cc5b310b31bc7b61213598aade9a5188964e)
premise.use: Ghat_e 1 <= w = A - B m on R for every e in the block => ||Ghat_e|| <= A = C_T and (Ghat_e 1)(a) <= A = tau

G_arithmetic_backend.exact: fractions.Fraction for every constant, candidate, box coordinate, atom bound, propagation, aggregate

H_rounding_policy: Taylor-model coefficients rounded by floor with the error added to the remainder; products truncated at order 6 with the dropped terms and the cross remainder bounded outward; |r_k| bounds rounded UP to rationals; phi/Phi enclosures outward (C7); the float proposal is rounded to 52-bit dyadics and then used EXACTLY (its error is part of the rigorously enclosed residual)
J_aggregation_rule: cell D1 = max over the 4 sub-blocks of D1_j; cell D2 = max of D2_j (upper bounds: max preserves 'for every e in the block'); within a sub-block lam_k = max over all leaves; atom bound = sup over h in [-de, de]. Never min, mean or a subset.

K_success_failure.CERTIFIED: all 4 sub-blocks complete within the caps with guards R0-R6 passed; the values are whatever the propagation yields (no size threshold)
K_success_failure.NOT_CERTIFIED: a resource cap ended the run; artifact written without values; both targets INSUFFICIENT at comparison
K_success_failure.NO_RESULT: the process died before writing its artifact; the execution is consumed (see O)

L_agreement_criterion.rule: C11R's factor-2 rule frozen before any result (statement table comparison_semantics_frozen_before_results), UNCHANGED: for an UPPER_BOUND, STRONGER if independent <= original; AGREES if original < independent <= 2 original; INSUFFICIENT if independent > 2 original
L_agreement_criterion.statement_first: SAME STATEMENT BEFORE SAME NUMBER (C11R precedence): a statement that is not EQUIVALENT or STRONGER is INVALID and its number is not compared
L_agreement_criterion.opposite_direction: C11R's DISAGREES class (an independent bound whose quantity the original bounds from the other side); not reachable here since both sides are UPPER_BOUND of the same quantity
L_agreement_criterion.copied: an independent value exactly equal to the original is INVALID
L_agreement_criterion.n9: N9_CLOSED iff all six constants (C_T, tau, Abar, D_lo from C11R's accepted comparison, read not recomputed; D1, D2 from C11RD) are AGREES or STRONGER; precedence INDEPENDENCE_VIOLATION > SCIENTIFIC_DISAGREEMENT > EXECUTION_INVALID > N9_CLOSED > AGREEMENT_INSUFFICIENT; otherwise N9_REMAINS_OPEN

M_resource_cap.why: worst case 13,664 box evaluations ~ 7.6 h at 10 CPU-s each on 5 workers (docs/C11RD_COST_MODEL.md)

N_memory_cap.check: every 30 s over the parent and all workers

O_retry_policy: none automatic. The lock is taken before any science and never removed. Cap reached: NOT_CERTIFIED artifact, no retry. Host fault before the artifact: a second execution only under a new, independently reviewed authorization, and only if no magnitude was ever written or printed (the log carries counters and timings only). After a valid execution: never.
